description: Fetch the FULL record for one already-discovered company by its `domain` — the detail behind a `search_prospects` summary or a `found[]` domain. Returns every field (contacts, personal + company emails, registry data, address, social profiles, scores, description), not the lean summary. Does not run a new discovery and does not cost credits. A domain you have not discovered comes back as a structured `not_found` status rather than an error.
name: get_prospect
title: Get prospect detail
